notes.title: Unveiling Grim Trials...💀⚔️
notes.notes:
[p][b]THE UNDERWORLD HAS A NEW REAPER. SHE'S SLAYING, BUT NOT STAYING![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]As part of [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Oe4Pm3nYGv8"]The Southeast Asian Games Showcase[/url]: Summer Game Fest Edition, we're unleashing a heavy metal action roguelite! 🎸[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="4ApR7CLyiUg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Please welcome our latest collaboration with [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/gloryjam"]Glory Jam[/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/softsource"]Soft Source[/url]: [/p][p][/p][h1]Grim Trials!💀⚔️[/h1][p][/p][p]Play as Avelin: a freshly-dead soul with endless resolve and a knack for spectacular violence. Tasked to hunt down impure souls as Death's newest Grim Reaper, she must face her demons, and hack, slash, and blast her way through a deadly underworld of her own making. Only the toughest Reapers graduate the trials, and Avelin's got a still-living loved one she needs to see again.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]WHAT TO EXPECT?[/b][/h3][p]⚔️ Craft, mix, and match your weapons and armor with an expansive skill tree[/p][p]🛡️ Endless hex-grid arenas filled with monsters, traps, and sinful souls[/p][p]🔥 Set the afterlife ablaze in swift, brutal combat where deftly swapping between melee and ranged combat is key [/p][p]💀 Death is no end, it's your edge. Keep every weapon, every upgrade, every scrap you find[/p][p][i]Carve your way back to the land of the living, over and over, until you see them again.
